_comment: Workbook exercise plant-boiler-cycling (docs/workbook/plant-boiler-cycling.md): boiler short-cycling, loop delta-T and pumping on the synthetic-hw-plant-cycling plants (generated by CAMBER, no real building), at the trend's own 15-minute resolution and the rules' defaults: boiler_short_cycle warns at 6 and faults at 12 starts a day, hw_plant_deltat judges against a 20 F design minimum, hw_pump_dp_reset counts speeds at or above 90 %. The variants plant-boiler-cycling--hourly (the same data resampled to 1h) and plant-boiler-cycling--10starts (a 10-starts-a-day limit) run boiler_short_cycle only.
